summary: KEPCO filed a Form 6-K to call an extraordinary general meeting of shareholders for June 17, 2026, to elect two standing directors and two non-standing audit committee members. The filing is a routine corporate governance notice with no special-situation transaction (no acquisition, divestiture, tender, restructuring, etc.). The agenda includes director elections with biographies and no mentions of a deal, premium, or strategic review. This is an ordinary procedural filing under the Exchange Act.
